lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
educai-admin: 2,643 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 2,065 B, generated by vite-plugin-node-polyfills 244 B, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 224 B.
educai-personal: 3,507 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 2,065 B, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 1,088 B, generated by vite-plugin-node-polyfills 244 B.
educai-bot-picker: 323 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 298 B, generated by typescript 17 B, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 8 B.
educai-main: 407 B beyond the first copy, generated by @vitejs/plugin-vue2 278 B, generated by vite 121 B, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 8 B.
core-js, 10,456 B on the educai-admin page: polyfills for browsers older than the build targets.
290,568 B in 1,416 pieces of 10 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (31 packages, 111 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in build is left without something that loads it.
